descriptions.value: When parsing an AS range in Routinator, if the maximum value of the range is smaller than the minimum value of the range, Routinator will never reach the maximum value and run out of memory.

descriptions.description: CWE-755 Improper Handling of Exceptional Conditions

assertions.title: Routinator may exit on malformed ranges

title: Routinator may exit on malformed ranges

descriptions.value: A path traversal issue was addressed with improved path validation. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27. A malicious app may be able to delete files for which it does not have privileges.

descriptions.description: A malicious app may be able to delete files for which it does not have privileges
